titulo: Which tab has been open all week? Cella answers
caption:
Which tab has been open all week? Cella answers.
She picked C: fill it out, then close it.
by NMR
#opentabs #relatable #cella
alt: A vertical video in flat colors, no voice, with soft music. The question reads: Which tab has been open all week? Four cards pop in: A, the recipe you won’t cook; B, the flight you won’t book; C, the form you won’t fill out; D, the one you’re scared to close. A small round figure with white eyes walks under card C and a red crown drops on it. Then the words are written: Cella: C. Fill it out, then close it.
